evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies wallet accounting logic in src/wallet/receive.cpp, and updates wallet history RPCs in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a long-standing accounting bug in wallet history RPCs for mixed-input transactions. As noted in issue #14136 open since 2018, wallet history RPCs assume all inputs belong to the wallet, fabricating false recipient send entries and producing incorrect or negative fee figures.
